measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

limitations.wanted: to size the nut pocket from the actual nut and bolt (measure) and to pick the interference from a printed fit coupon (print_test)
limitations.blocked_by: the person could not measure the nut/bolt and could not report how the coupon pockets came out
limitations.why: the pocket across-flats is the one dimension that decides whether the nut presses in by hand and stays in; without a reading I had to fall back on the ISO 4032 catalog value (8.0 mm) and a mid-range 0.15 mm interference, and I cannot confirm the bolt length either

findings.detail: hex pocket 7.85 across flats, 13.0 deep (nut 4.7 tall), opens to the bed
pocket 7.85 across flats, -0.15 over the 8.0 nut: prints say holds (assumed from the 0 mm clearance print, within the 0.2 mm assumption tolerance)
clear all the way through 20.0 mm: 5.50 at its narrowest (want at least 5.3)
hex pocket 7.85 across flats, 13.0 deep (nut 4.7 tall), opens to the bed
pocket 7.85 across flats, -0.15 over the 8.0 nut: prints say not measured; no test print in the manual
clear all the way through 20.0 mm: 5.50 at its narrowest (want at least 5.3)

cp_af_a.note: Hex pocket A (leftmost), across flats. Same as nominal nut = clearance fit, expected to fall out.

cp_af_b.note: Pocket B across flats (0.05 mm interference on a nominal 8.0 nut).

cp_af_c.note: Pocket C across flats (0.15 mm interference).

cp_af_d.note: Pocket D across flats (0.25 mm interference).

cp_af_e.note: Pocket E (rightmost) across flats (0.35 mm interference) - expect hard to press.

cp_lead_clear.note: Lead-in hex is this much larger across flats than the grip hex, so the nut drops in easily.

cp_taper_h.note: 45 deg taper from lead-in hex down to the grip hex.

cp_nut_h.note: ISO 4032 M5 nut height - sets the top of the grip band.

cp_nut_gap.note: Nut face sits this far inside the entry face.

cp_ceiling.note: Wall above the pocket ceiling; the bore passes through it.

cp_h.note: Coupon block height = pocket depth + ceiling.

cp_bore.note: Bolt clearance hole through the ceiling (5.5 mm clears an M5 shank).
